name: Warrior 1 Pose
description: Lunge with the back heel down, the hips facing forward, and the arms overhead.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand tall, then step one foot back about a leg's length.
Turn the back foot out a little with the heel down, and face your hips forward.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Warrior 1
keyframes.cue: Step the left foot back, bend the right knee, and reach up.
